In the diagram, $Q$ lies on the segment $PT$. The given vectors are $\overrightarrow{OP}=w$ and $\overrightarrow{OT}=n$. The lengths satisfy $PQ:QT=1:1$.

Express $\overrightarrow{OQ}$ in terms of $w$ and $n$. Fill in both coefficients, including their signs.

$\overrightarrow{OQ}=$ {{field-1}} $w+$ {{field-2}} $n$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First express both endpoint vectors in the directions away from $O$:

$$
\overrightarrow{OP}=w\qquad \overrightarrow{OT}=n .
$$

Trace the path from $P$ through $O$ to $T$:

$$
\overrightarrow{PT}=\overrightarrow{PO}+\overrightarrow{OT}=-w+n.
$$

The ratio $PQ:QT=1:1$ gives $2$ parts in the whole segment. Thus

$$
\overrightarrow{PQ}=\frac{1}{2}\overrightarrow{PT}=\frac{1}{2}(-w+n).
$$

Add along the path $O\to P\to Q$ and collect coefficients:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{OQ}&=\overrightarrow{OP}+\overrightarrow{PQ}\\&=w+\frac{1}{2}(-w+n)\\&=\frac{1}{2}w+\frac{1}{2}n.\end{aligned}
$$

Express $\overrightarrow{OJ}$ in terms of $t$ and $v$.
question.:question/worked-solution:
First express both endpoint vectors in the directions away from $O$:

$$
\overrightarrow{OA}=t\qquad \overrightarrow{OD}=v .
$$

Trace the path from $A$ through $O$ to $D$:

$$
\overrightarrow{AD}=\overrightarrow{AO}+\overrightarrow{OD}=-t+v.
$$

The ratio $AJ:JD=7:1$ gives $8$ parts in the whole segment. Thus

$$
\overrightarrow{AJ}=\frac{7}{8}\overrightarrow{AD}=\frac{7}{8}(-t+v).
$$

Add along the path $O\to A\to J$ and collect coefficients:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{OJ}&=\overrightarrow{OA}+\overrightarrow{AJ}\\&=t+\frac{7}{8}(-t+v)\\&=\frac{1}{8}t+\frac{7}{8}v.\end{aligned}
$$

\overrightarrow{OM}=b\qquad \overrightarrow{OQ}=v .

$$

In the diagram, $D$ lies on the segment $EL$. The given vectors are $\overrightarrow{OE}=p$ and $\overrightarrow{OL}=q$. The lengths satisfy $ED:DL=1:10$.

Express $\overrightarrow{OD}$ in terms of $p$ and $q$. Fill in both coefficients, including their signs.

$\overrightarrow{OD}=$ {{field-1}} $p+$ {{field-2}} $q$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First express both endpoint vectors in the directions away from $O$:

$$
\overrightarrow{OE}=p\qquad \overrightarrow{OL}=q .
$$

Trace the path from $E$ through $O$ to $L$:

$$
\overrightarrow{EL}=\overrightarrow{EO}+\overrightarrow{OL}=-p+q.
$$

The ratio $ED:DL=1:10$ gives $11$ parts in the whole segment. Thus

$$
\overrightarrow{ED}=\frac{1}{11}\overrightarrow{EL}=\frac{1}{11}(-p+q).
$$

Add along the path $O\to E\to D$ and collect coefficients:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{OD}&=\overrightarrow{OE}+\overrightarrow{ED}\\&=p+\frac{1}{11}(-p+q)\\&=\frac{10}{11}p+\frac{1}{11}q.\end{aligned}
$$
